newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates end down at 20.5 pct in slow mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates end down at 20.5 pct in slow mkt.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates dropped on Saturday on slack demand in a slow market, dealers said.
The overnight rates opened at 20.875/21.125 and finished at 20.5 percent, compared with Friday's close of 21 percent.
"Turnover is very low, many banks are closed," said Kalman Pomazi, director of the treasury of Magyar Hitel Bank (MHB).
Saturday is a working day in Hungary, to replace next Friday, which will be part of four days of holidays.
But few banks were present on the money market and dealers said the foreign exchange market was not likely to open at all, with the foreign markets closed.
